ne29:1.1: And which is the sense-word treatment?
ne29:2.1: “Therefore the guarded in mind has right purpose as its destination” is a verse.
ne29:2.2: “Therefore the guarded in mind”: by knowing it, by having discerned it, the term for it is mind, mentation, consciousness, mind-faculty, and mind-sense-sphere. This is the sense-word.
ne29:2.3: “Right purpose as its destination”: the term for it is the right purpose of giving up, the right purpose of non-harm, and the right purpose of non-cruelty. This is the sense-word.
ne29:2.4: “The mere shadow of right view”: the term for it is that right view is called the aim of wisdom, the summit of wisdom, the jewel of wisdom, the light of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, and the assurance of wisdom. This is the sense-word.
ne29:2.5: The sense-word treatment has been fully defined.
